mapper.select: select param_code, param_value from T_XWYY_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT b.spec_code FROM T_BOM_INFO b INNER JOIN T_XWYY_PARAMS p ON p.param_value = b.spec_name WHERE b.TIER = 4 AND p.param_code = 'ORIGINAL_LINE_BOM_NAME' AND p.del_flag = '0' AND b.del_flag = '0'
SELECT MAX(BATCH_NO) BATCH_NO FROM T_XWYY_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD WHERE schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into T_XWYY_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD (ID, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, STATUS, SCHEDULE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG) values (SEQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD.Nextval, #{cxBatchNo}, #{batchNo}, #{status}, #{scheduleDate}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{delFlag})

INSERT INTO T_XWYY_SCHEDULE_RESULT_LOG (ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CD90_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BIG_ROLL_CODE, ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, ORIGINAL_LINE_QTY_NUM, MACHINE_ID, SUPPLY_TIME, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_PLAN_QTY_NUM, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PROCESS_VALUE, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY_NUM, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PROCESS_VALUE, YES_STOCK, TODAY_STOCK, DAY_USED, DAY_OUT, FAC2_CLASS1_PLAN, FAC2_CLASS2_PLAN, FAC2_CLASS3_PLAN, FAC2_TOTAL_PLAN, FAC5_CLASS1_PLAN, FAC5_CLASS2_PLAN, FAC5_CLASS3_PLAN, FAC5_TOTAL_PLAN, TOTAL_PLAN, RUBBER_CODE, RUBBER_CAR_NUMBER, ORIGINAL_BRAND, ORIGINAL_BRAND_NUM, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME, EXTRA_PLAN_FLAG, ORIGINAL_REMIND_FLAG, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, data_source) SELECT ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CD90_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BIG_ROLL_CODE, ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, ORIGINAL_LINE_QTY_NUM, MACHINE_ID, SUPPLY_TIME, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_PLAN_QTY_NUM, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PROCESS_VALUE, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY_NUM, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PROCESS_VALUE, YES_STOCK, TODAY_STOCK, DAY_USED, DAY_OUT, FAC2_CLASS1_PLAN, FAC2_CLASS2_PLAN, FAC2_CLASS3_PLAN, FAC2_TOTAL_PLAN, FAC5_CLASS1_PLAN, FAC5_CLASS2_PLAN, FAC5_CLASS3_PLAN, FAC5_TOTAL_PLAN, TOTAL_PLAN, RUBBER_CODE, RUBBER_CAR_NUMBER, ORIGINAL_BRAND, ORIGINAL_BRAND_NUM, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME, EXTRA_PLAN_FLAG, ORIGINAL_REMIND_FLAG, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, data_source FROM T_XWYY_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT R.EMBRYO_CODE CLOTH_CODE FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R LEFT JOIN (SELECT CI.CORD_SPEC, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, EMBRYO_VERSION, EMBRYO_CODE FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' UNION SELECT CI.CORD_SPEC, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, EMBRYO_VERSION, EMBRYO_CODE FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CI.CORD_SPEC, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, EMBRYO_VERSION, EMBRYO_CODE FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 IS NOT NULL) CI ON CI.EMBRYO_CODE = R.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION WHERE CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE IS NULL AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.Del_Flag = '0'

WITH temp_tab_BIG_ROLL_CODE AS (
SELECT #{schedule.bigRollCode} big_roll_code FROM dual
) SELECT CI.CORD_SPEC BIG_ROLL_CODE, MAX(CI.ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE) ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, MAX(CX_BATCH_NO) CX_BATCH_NO, NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY * CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH * (nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, 0)) / #{breadth} / 1000 / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN, NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY * CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH * (nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, 0)) / #{breadth} / 1000 / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN, NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY * CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH * (nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, 0)) / #{breadth} / 1000 / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN, NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY * CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH * (nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, 0)) / #{breadth} / 1000 / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS4_PLAN, NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY * CI.SIDEWALL_LENGTH * (nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, 0) + nvl(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, 0)) / #{breadth} / 1000 / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS5_PLAN FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI LEFT JOIN T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.CORD_SPEC IN ( SELECT big_roll_code FROM temp_tab_BIG_ROLL_CODE ) GROUP BY CI.CORD_SPEC
UNION
SELECT B.CHILD_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, MAX(C.CHILD_CODE) ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, null, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM T_BOM_INFO B INNER JOIN T_BOM_INFO C ON C.PARENT_MATERIAL_CODE = B.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE AND C.STATUS = '1' AND C.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'NYLON_CORD' WHERE B.STATUS = '1' AND B.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'RUBBER_COVERED' AND b.child_code IN (SELECT big_roll_code FROM temp_tab_BIG_ROLL_CODE) AND NOT EXISTS (select 0 from T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.CORD_SPEC = B.CHILD_CODE) GROUP BY B.CHILD_CODE
SELECT * FROM T_XWYY_ASSIST_SPEC R WHERE R.DEL_FLAG = '0'
mapper.delete: UPDATE T_XWYY_ASSIST_SCHEDULE SET DEL_FLAG = '1' WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
mapper.select: SELECT ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, ORIGINAL_LINE_LENGTH, BREAK_ROLL_NUM FROM T_XWYY_ORIGINAL_LINE_SPEC T WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT R.BIG_ROLL_CODE, MAX(NVL(R.DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0) * NVL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, NVL(TO_NUMBER(P1.PARAM_VALUE), 400))) DAY_PLAN_QTY, MAX(NVL(R.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) * NVL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, NVL(TO_NUMBER(P1.PARAM_VALUE), 400))) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, MAX(NVL(R.DAY_OUT, 0) * NVL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, NVL(TO_NUMBER(P1.PARAM_VALUE), 400))) DAY_OUT, MAX(NVL(R.FAC5_CLASS1_PLAN, 0) * NVL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, NVL(TO_NUMBER(P1.PARAM_VALUE), 400))) FAC5_CLASS1_PLAN, MAX(NVL(R.FAC5_CLASS2_PLAN, 0) * NVL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, NVL(TO_NUMBER(P1.PARAM_VALUE), 400))) FAC5_CLASS2_PLAN, MAX(NVL(R.FAC5_CLASS3_PLAN, 0) * NVL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, NVL(TO_NUMBER(P1.PARAM_VALUE), 400))) FAC5_CLASS3_PLAN, MAX(NVL(CI.ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, BO.ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE)) ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE FROM T_XWYY_ASSIST_REQUIREMENT R LEFT JOIN T_CD90_BIG_ROLL B ON B.BIG_ROLL_CODE = R.BIG_ROLL_CODE AND B.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN T_XWYY_PARAMS P1 ON P1.PARAM_CODE = 'STANDARD_SIZE' AND P1.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.BIG_ROLL_CODE = CI.CORD_SPEC AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN (SELECT B.CHILD_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, B.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE SAP_CODE, MAX(C.CHILD_CODE) ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE FROM T_BOM_INFO B INNER JOIN T_BOM_INFO C ON C.PARENT_MATERIAL_CODE = B.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE AND C.STATUS = '1' AND C.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'NYLON_CORD' WHERE B.STATUS = '1' AND B.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'RUBBER_COVERED' GROUP BY B.CHILD_CODE, B.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE) BO ON BO.BIG_ROLL_CODE = R.BIG_ROLL_CODE WHERE R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND (NVL(R.DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0) != 0 OR NVL(R.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) != 0 OR NVL(R.FAC5_CLASS1_PLAN, 0) != 0 OR NVL(R.FAC5_CLASS2_PLAN, 0) != 0 OR NVL(R.FAC5_CLASS3_PLAN, 0) != 0 ) GROUP BY R.BIG_ROLL_CODE
